requests.query: multivariate Hasse derivative polynomial sum support monomial binomial coefficient
Hasse Schmidt derivative Taylor expansion polynomial arbitrary commutative ring
Finsupp lsum applied to finitely supported function equals sum of linear maps

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : Semiring R] → ℕ → Polynomial R →ₗ[R] Polynomial R

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_apply
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ) (f : Polynomial R),
  (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) f = f.sum fun i r => (Polynomial.monomial (i - k)) (↑(i.choose k) * r)

items.name: Polynomial.as_sum_support
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R), p = ∑ i ∈ p.support, (Polynomial.monomial i) (p.coeff i)

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_monomial
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k n : ℕ) (r : R),
  (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) ((Polynomial.monomial n) r) = (Polynomial.monomial (n - k)) (↑(n.choose k) * r)

items.name: MvPolynomial.support_sum_monomial_coeff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
  ∑ v ∈ p.support, (MvPolynomial.monomial v) (MvPolynomial.coeff v p) = p

items.name: MvPolynomial.sum_def
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] {A : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid A] {p : MvPolynomial σ R}
  {b : (σ →₀ ℕ) → R → A}, Finsupp.sum p b = ∑ m ∈ p.support, b m (MvPolynomial.coeff m p)

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_comp
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k l : ℕ),
  Polynomial.hasseDeriv k ∘ₗ Polynomial.hasseDeriv l = (k + l).choose k • Polynomial.hasseDeriv (k + l)

items.name: MvPolynomial.support
items.type: {R : Type u} → {σ : Type u_1} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → MvPolynomial σ R → Finset (σ →₀ ℕ)

items.name: Polynomial.taylor_coeff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  ((Polynomial.taylor r) f).coeff n = Polynomial.eval r ((Polynomial.hasseDeriv n) f)

items.name: Polynomial.taylor
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : Semiring R] → R → Polynomial R →ₗ[R] Polynomial R

items.name: Polynomial.taylor_apply
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R),
  (Polynomial.taylor r) f = f.comp (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C r)

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_apply
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ) (f : Polynomial R),
  (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) f = f.sum fun i r => (Polynomial.monomial (i - k)) (↑(i.choose k) * r)

items.name: Polynomial.taylor_pow
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  (Polynomial.taylor r) (f ^ n) = (Polynomial.taylor r) f ^ n

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : Semiring R] → ℕ → Polynomial R →ₗ[R] Polynomial R

items.name: Polynomial.taylor_eval
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R) (s : R),
  Polynomial.eval s ((Polynomial.taylor r) f) = Polynomial.eval (s + r) f

items.name: Polynomial.taylor_taylor
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : Polynomial R) (r s : R),
  (Polynomial.taylor r) ((Polynomial.taylor s) f) = (Polynomial.taylor (r + s)) f

items.name: DFinsupp.lsum_apply_apply
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} (S : Type u_4) {M : ι → Type u_5} {N : Type u_6} [inst : Semiring R]
  [inst_1 : (i : ι) → AddCommMonoid (M i)] [inst_2 : (i : ι) → Module R (M i)] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid N]
  [inst_4 : Module R N] [inst_5 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_6 : Semiring S] [inst_7 : Module S N]
  [inst_8 : SMulCommClass R S N] (F : (i : ι) → M i →ₗ[R] N) (a : Π₀ (i : ι), M i),
  ((DFinsupp.lsum S) F) a = (DFinsupp.sumAddHom fun i => (F i).toAddMonoidHom) a

items.name: Finsupp.lsum_apply
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {N : Type u_3} {R : Type u_5} {R₂ : Type u_6} (S : Type u_8) [inst : Semiring R]
  [inst_1 : Semiring R₂] [inst_2 : Semiring S] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_4 : Module R M]
  [inst_5 : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_6 : Module R₂ N] {σ : R →+* R₂} [inst_7 : Module S N] [inst_8 : SMulCommClass R₂ S N]
  (f : α → M →ₛₗ[σ] N) (l : α →₀ M), ((Finsupp.lsum S) f) l = l.sum fun b => ⇑(f b)

items.name: LinearMap.finsupp_sum_apply
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_4} {R₂ : Type u_5} {M : Type u_6} {M₂ : Type u_7} {ι : Type u_8} [inst : Semiring R]
  [inst_1 : Semiring R₂] [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid M₂] {σ₁₂ : R →+* R₂} [inst_4 : Module R M]
  [inst_5 : Module R₂ M₂] {γ : Type u_9} [inst_6 : Zero γ] (t : ι →₀ γ) (g : ι → γ → M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂) (b : M),
  (t.sum g) b = t.sum fun i d => (g i d) b

items.name: Finsupp.lsum_single
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {N : Type u_3} {R : Type u_5} {R₂ : Type u_6} (S : Type u_8) [inst : Semiring R]
  [inst_1 : Semiring R₂] [inst_2 : Semiring S] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_4 : Module R M]
  [inst_5 : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_6 : Module R₂ N] {σ : R →+* R₂} [inst_7 : Module S N] [inst_8 : SMulCommClass R₂ S N]
  (f : α → M →ₛₗ[σ] N) (i : α) (m : M), ((Finsupp.lsum S) f) (Finsupp.single i m) = (f i) m

items.name: LinearMap.dfinsuppSum_apply
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_7} {R₂ : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} {M₂ : Type u_10} {ι : Type u_11} [inst : Semiring R]
  [inst_1 : Semiring R₂] [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid M₂] {σ₁₂ : R →+* R₂} [inst_4 : Module R M]
  [inst_5 : Module R₂ M₂] {γ : ι → Type u_12} [inst_6 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_7 : (i : ι) → Zero (γ i)]
  [inst_8 : (i : ι) → (x : γ i) → Decidable (x ≠ 0)] (t : Π₀ (i : ι), γ i) (g : (i : ι) → γ i → M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂) (b : M),
  (t.sum g) b = t.sum fun i d => (g i d) b

items.name: LinearMap.coe_finsupp_sum
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_4} {R₂ : Type u_5} {M : Type u_6} {M₂ : Type u_7} {ι : Type u_8} [inst : Semiring R]
  [inst_1 : Semiring R₂] [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid M₂] {σ₁₂ : R →+* R₂} [inst_4 : Module R M]
  [inst_5 : Module R₂ M₂] {γ : Type u_9} [inst_6 : Zero γ] (t : ι →₀ γ) (g : ι → γ → M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂),
  ⇑(t.sum g) = ⇑(t.sum fun i d => g i d)
